units: unitless original artist coordinates; no avatar/source-image measurement

grid.rows: 0..109 rings, single top vertex y1.1; bottom disk cap at y-1.1
grid.interpolation: piecewise cubic Hermite; endpoint slopes one-sided, interior slopes adjacent secant across two knots; no clamp/fit/tuning

facial_features.support: front hemisphere only, multiply every Z sculpt by max(cos(phi),0)^4; skin vertices remain one connected head/neck surface
facial_features.gaussians: height*exp(-((x-x0)/sx)^2-((y-y0)/sy)^2), all positions evaluated once then Float32

lip_model.shape: two connected skin ridges and recessed closed resting seam; no mouth opening/interior or speech claim

ears.surface: continuous radial deformation of the same skin rings, no separate nose/ear markers
ears.limits: original coarse attached pinnal volume/recess; no anatomy/ear-canal/physical solid certificate

eyes.model: two sculpted skin eyelid rims and complete concave closed orbital cups joined into skin, each with one independent closed companion-eye surface. Deliberate rim/eye occlusion, not physical union/contact calibration
eyes.skin_hole: omit only patch-interior grid vertices and grid cells whose whole cell lies inside the closed index rectangle. Each perimeter vertex is remapped to the same ordered oval using atan2((j-midJ)/halfJ,(u-midU)/halfU), X=cx+rx*cos(a), Y=cy+ry*sin(a). Adjacent skin faces keep those same boundary indices. No unreachable vertices exported.
eyes.rim_z: faceZ at asin(X/profileWidth(Y)), plus .020*max(sin(a),0)^2 and .006*max(-sin(a),0)^2 for connected upper/lower lid relief
eyes.perimeter_order: start lower-left; u+ on lower edge, j+ on right edge, u- on upper edge, j- on left, no duplicate corners; 40 vertices per oval

cup_back.face_pattern: for each k, rim[k],rim[next],back[next]; rim[k],back[next],back[k]; cap back[k],back[next],centre; shared skin perimeter edge directions opposite. All cup vertices remain skin part.

companion.topology: shared polar rings with single front/rear pole; closed surface, per-face material at mean theta, no separate iris/pupil marker volumes
companion.limits: static frontal iris/pupil material regions; no optical cornea, dynamic gaze/blink or finished-eye claim

skin_topology.ring_winding: a(j,u),b(j,u+1),d(j+1,u+1); a,d,c(j+1,u), wrapping u once. Omit eye patch interior cells. Shared original grid/rim IDs cached once. Top fan current,next,top; bottom fan bottom,next,current. Orbital cup closure above uses the same skin boundary IDs.
skin_topology.closedness: one connected indexed skin component with ears/nose/lips/neck/lids/cups, oriented paired edges and cycle vertex links; independent2closedeyecomponents. No claim that separate solids Boolean-union or are a calibrated embedding.
skin_topology.materials_by_skin_face_centroid: Brow if front hemisphere and |abs(x)-.225|<.15 and |y-(.405-.055*((abs(x)-.225)/.15)^2)|<.014; otherwise Lips if front and (x/.18)^2+((y+.275)/.054)^2<1; otherwise Skin. Cups always Skin.
skin_topology.normals: after one Float32 position quantization, sum oriented triangle cross products at shared indices, normalize and quantize Float32 once; no tangent/coordinate repair

landmark_intentions: bridge/tip/alar/nostril surfaces from full connected skin sculpt
jaw/chin full height profiles and connected chin field
rear/whole cranium from independent profile depths
neck base planeY-1.1disk; no body attachment or fit
exports: mesh.json all Float32 skin/eye positions,normals,triangles,face-material IDs,feature/perimeter/source IDs
prohibited: No image projection, g100/g050/body/head/mask/rig/material/texture import; no copied scaffold, old hair net or current expression-channel/PAD tuning; no preset/native/capture/retake rescue
